name: Thousand Dollar Soul
source: Todd has no friends, and is one week from graduating high school. One day at lunch a strange man shows up and says, "I'm you, from the future!" Future Todd is apparently here to help Todd win the heart of his crush, Angela. But what is Future Todd's real plan?
